title: Approximating neutron-star radii using gravitational-wave only measurements with symbolic regression
abstract: arXiv:2504.19962v3 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gravitational waves emitted by binary neutron-star inspirals carry information on components' masses and tidal deformabilities, but not directly radii, which are measured by electromagnetic observations of neutron stars. To improve the multi-messenger astronomy studies of neutron stars, an expression for neutron-star radii as a function of gravitational-wave only data would be advantageous, as it would allow to compare information from two different channels. In order to do so, a symbolic regression method, pySR, is trained on TOV solutions to piecewise polytropic EOS input to discover an approximate symbolic expression for the neutron-star radius as a function of gravitational-wave measurements only. translated_title: 利用符号回归基于纯引力波测量近似估计中子星半径
translated_abstract: 双中子星旋近系统发出的引力波携带了组件质量和潮汐形变参数的信息，但不直接包含半径信息，后者是通过电磁观测来测量的。为了改进中子星的多信使天文学研究，将中子星半径表示为仅基于引力波数据的函数表达式将大有裨益，因为它允许比较来自两个不同观测通道的信息。为此，作者在分段多方物态方程（EOS）输入的TOV解上训练符号回归方法pySR，以发现一个仅作为引力波测量量函数的中子星半径近似符号表达式。该近似在分段多方物态方程的中子星数据以及基于选定的真实（非多方）致密物质理论物态方程的中子星序列上进行了测试，在真实值与符号表达式之间取得了一致的良好符合。
tldr: 本文利用符号回归方法pySR，仅基于引力波测量数据（质量和潮汐形变参数）发现了中子星半径的近似符号表达式，并在多种真实物态方程数据上验证了其一致性，为引力波与电磁观测的多信使中子星研究提供了桥梁。
en_tdlr: This paper employs symbolic regression (pySR) to discover an approximate symbolic expression for neutron-star radii based solely on gravitational-wave measurements, validated across piecewise polytropic and realistic equation-of-state data, bridging gravitational-wave and electromagnetic multi-messenger studies.
